title: Partner prep, hedged acceptance and a spoken anchor date

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm Maya Chen, and today is Monday, March second, twenty twenty six.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And I'm Daniel Okafor. Short one today, we have two items.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The API documentation needs a refresh before the partner call.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I might be able to get to it. I can't promise anything this week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let's call it a maybe. Ask me again on Wednesday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Understood, we are not counting on it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Separately, the staging database has no backup job. I'll set that up by this Friday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And should we tell the partner about the delay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm not sure. Let's decide after the call.
